Planning a dream trip to Mauritius from India?
In this Mauritius travel vlog, we share complete information on how to plan a Mauritius trip from India, including visa details, flight tips, budget planning, best time to visit, currency, local transport, and must-know travel tips.
After covering all the essential Mauritius travel planning information, we take you along to explore some of the most beautiful places in Mauritius — from crystal-clear beaches and turquoise lagoons to scenic viewpoints, local markets, and hidden gems.
